The '''Destruction of the Cauldron Nebula''' occurred in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], when [[Kyp Durron]] used the [[Sun Crusher]] to attack [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Maw fleet|forces]] in the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]].

==Origins==
Following her defeat in the [[attack on Mon Calamari]], Daala had her forces retreat to the Cauldron Nebula. She began to plan an attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she would move the majority of her personnel to the ''[[Gorgon]]'' and leave a skeleton crew aboard the [[Basilisk (Star Destroyer)|''Basilisk'']], who would detonate it above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], killing themselves in the process.<ref name="DA" />

Meanwhile, under the influence of the spirit of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] pulled the [[Sun Crusher]] out of the gas-giant, [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], and left with it to destroy the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnants]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Kun told him the location of Daala's forces and he set out to destroy them, to signal to the other Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] the fate that was about to befall them.<ref name="DA" />

==The destruction of the nebula==
Kyp arrived in the nebula and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to find the exact location of Daala's ships. He fired off seven [[resonance torpedo]]s, one for each star in the nebula, and pulled away to wait until the stars exploded a few hours later. However, as he waited, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] began powering up their [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]], to leave for Coruscant. Kyp became angry and decided to try and make Daala stay there. As the Star Destroyers prepared to engage their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], he opened fire on the ''Gorgon'' with the Sun Crusher's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mullinore]] informed Daala that he had identified the attacker as the Sun Crusher and she ordered two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadrons to launch to try and capture it.<ref name="DA" />

The Sun Crusher began to fly away and Daala wondered why it was no longer attacking them, as she ordered her ships to move about, so as to lock their [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] onto the Sun Crusher. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kratas]] told her that this would be difficult, due to the Sun Crusher's high speed, but she ordered him to try anyway. Kyp then commed the ''Gorgon'' with a voice-only transmission and revealed to Daala his identity. She told him that, if he surrendered the Sun Crusher to them intact, she would take him to any planet of his choice. He refused and ended the conversation.<ref name="DA" />

The ''Gorgon''{{'s}} sensor chief then informed Daala that he was getting some unusual readings from the stars and she realized what Kyp had done. She ordered the two Star Destroyers to turn around and leave immediately. The ''Gorgon''s [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] had lost its lock on Coruscant, so the ship was forced to randomly jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="DA" /> Seconds later, the stars exploded and destroyed the more slower moving ''Basilisk'' and the two TIE Fighter squadrons.<ref name="CotF" />

==Aftermath==
Kyp believed Daala to be dead and left one of the Sun Crusher's message cylinders so that the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] would know who caused her death. He then left for the world of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], which he [[Destruction of Carida|destroyed]] soon after.<ref name="CotF" />

The ''Gorgon'' emerged in an uninhabited void in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], where the crew set about repairing the damage caused to it as the inferno surrounded it as it jumped to hyperspace, in preparation for its [[Battle of the Maw|return]] to the [[Maw Installation]].<ref name="CotF" />
